purpose.text: Automated workflow to identify, list, and remove stale files older than seven days from the system scratch directory, followed by disk usage verification.
purpose.quote: Automated workflow to identify, list, and remove stale files older than seven days from the system s

scope.text: Applies to system operations and authorized agents.
scope.quote: Applies to system operations and authorized agents.

steps.action: Verify the target temporary folder path exists.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout is 'True', set variables.path_exists = true, else set variables.path_exists = false
steps.quote: Verify the target temporary folder path exists.

steps.action: List stale files older than seven days in the scratch directory.
steps.input: Get-ChildItem -Path '{{entities.scratch_path}}' -File | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -lt (Get-Date).AddDays(-7) } | Select-Object Name, LastWriteTime, Length
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout is not empty, set variables.stale_files_found = true, else set variables.stale_files_found = false
steps.quote: List stale files older than seven days in the scratch directory.

steps.action: Remove stale temporary files older than seven days.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.cleanup_completed = true, else set variables.cleanup_completed = false
steps.quote: Remove stale temporary files older than seven days.

steps.action: Verify remaining disk usage on the drive containing the scratch directory.
steps.quote: Verify remaining disk usage on the drive containing the scratch directory.
